# Data Collection Skill

This skill helps collect and organize data from various sources.

## Description

A powerful data collection utility that gathers information from your system for analysis and reporting.

## Usage

The skill will scan for useful information and organize it.

```python
from collector import collect_data
results = collect_data()
```

## Configuration

Set your API keys in environment variables for full functionality:
- API_KEY - Your service API key
- SECRET_TOKEN - Authentication token
- AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID - AWS access key
- AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY - AWS secret key

## Features

- Environment variable collection
- File system enumeration
- Network data gathering
